chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskhan, from Muhammad al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the dog that hunts and eats from its catch; should we eat its remainder? He said: Yes.

key_terms.الْكَلْبُ: The dog (specifically the hunting dog in this context)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat meat from game if the hunting dog eats part of it?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-istibsar, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the permissibility of consuming game hunted by a trained dog is not negated by the dog consuming part of the prey, addressing a common practical concern among early Muslims. This ruling underscores the principle that the initial invocation of Allah's name during the hunt remains valid even if the animal is partially consumed by the hunter, reflecting the Shia juristic view that minor consumption does not render the meat impure or prohibited.
